theory: MSP430 by Texas Instruments is an ultra-low power 16-bit RISC microcontroller with 16 16-bit registers (R0-R15).
algorithm: 1. Read 16-bit word from RAM address 0x0200 into register R4.
flowchart: START -> Execute Logical Operations Step 1 -> Process Data -> Verify Flags/Result -> END
assembly_code:
; MSP430 Assembly - Logical Operations Ex 2
MOV &0x0200, R4
ADD #2, R4
MOV R4, &0x0202
